text:
If you run a small business, you don't need a dashboard. You need three numbers every week:

1. Enquiries: calls, WhatsApp, DMs and walk-ins, added together
2. Customers: how many of those bought or booked
3. Source: where the enquiries came from (Google, Instagram, referral, walk-in)

These three tell you where the problem is:
→ Enquiries down? Visibility problem: Google profile, content, ads
→ Enquiries up, customers flat? Follow-up problem: slow replies, no reminders
→ One source carries everything? That's where your time and money should go

Most owners know their sales. Very few know their enquiries, so they fix the wrong thing.

A notebook works. A Google Sheet works better. An automatic WhatsApp report every Monday works best.
